```{r}
source("../R/site-data.R")
source("../R/software.R")

# The package table is the `software` tab of the Google Sheet, read through the
# shared data layer (R/site-data.R). It is refreshed by itself when it is older
# than a day, and a failed fetch falls back to the last saved copy.
sw <- site_data()$tabs$software
if (!is.data.frame(sw) || nrow(sw) == 0)
  stop("No software data yet. Run  Rscript R/update-data.R  from the project root.")
sw$logo <- software_logo(sw$logo)
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
gen_software_table(sw)
```
